description: Removal of Condition 7 (Air Quality) for installation of mechanical ventilation for all residential units across the whole development at all floors. The air inlet should be positioned, where feasible, at the highest possible point above 13.5m following planning permission 01054H/527/P5 dated 28/05/2019 variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for an enlargement to the third floor along the northern elevation, external alterations to the elevations and site layout, including to the car parking, refuse storage, cycle storage, landscaping and fenestration arrangement, and revised internal layouts including alterations to the size of some of the flats and to ensure the Wheelchair Units are fully compliant, in relation to planning permission 01054H/527/P4 approved 04/07/2017 for the demolition of existing buildings and the erection of part five-, part four-storey block providing a total of 67 flats; associated access, landscaping, refuse storage, and car and cycle parking (amended description and plans).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Previously approved plans: 
P215020/001, P215020/010, P215020/030, P215020/031, Flood Risk Assessment ref. HLEF33437/003R dated July 2016 produced by RPS, Design and Access Statement dated 13-06-2016 produced by KKM Architects, Energy Statement ref. HLEU39668/001Rv1 dated May 2016 produced by RPS, Air Quality Assessment ref. AQ101903R1 dated 6th June 2016 produced by REC, Desk Study Report ref. GWPR1041/DS/February 2015 produced by Ground and water limited, Daylight, Sunlight and Overshadowing Assessment ref. AQ101390R2 dated 13th June 2016 produced by REC, Tree Survey Report ref. CBA10308v1 date November 2016 produced by CBA trees, Preliminary Ecological Appraisal ref. JSL2409_871 b dated December 2014 produced by RPS, Draft Construction Logistics Plan ref. BHHounslow.1 dated May 2015 produced by mayer brown, External Building Fabric Assessment ref. 7393/EBF dated 13 June 2016 by RBA Acoustics, Planning Statement ref. 36052 dated June 2016 produced by Peter Brett Associates, Transport Statement ref. BPAHounslow.1 dated June 2016, Code for Sustainable Homes Pre-assessment report ref. HLEU39668/001R dated May 2015 produced by RPS received 05/07/2016 Financial Viability Report dated 23rd June 2016 produced by GL Hearn Limited received 04/08/2016. P215020/128, Sunpower E20/327 SOLAR PANEL specification, 38 x Part L Regulations Compliance Report dated 05 August 2015 received 10/08/2016. Daylight, Sunlight and Overshadowing Assessment Technical Addendum produced by REC received 05/09/2016, P215020/150B, MBSK161005-1 and MBSK161005-2 received on 11/10/2016. Elemental Cost Summary produced by Capita received 12/10/2016. Budget Estimate dated Oct-16 produced by 2Plan Project Management Ltd, Asbestos Management Survey dated 21 November 2011 produced by Vital Property Solut

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan (Construction Design and Management Regulations 2007 Construction Phase Health & Safety Plan dated 01 August 2017 prepared by Semilarhus Development Limited received on 10/08/2017; Construction Management and Logistics Plan received on 02/10/2017) approved on 06/10/2017 under 01054H/527/P4(3).

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the external materials specified in the application and associated plans and supporting information.
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details of the glazed link with planters, winter gardens, balconies, privacy screens and trellises.

Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details of the scheme of acoustic insulation (Acoustic Commissioning Test Report by MLM Consulting Engineers Limited, dated 29 November 2019 (received 18 December 2019) and Fa?ade Commissioning Test Report by MLM Consulting Engineers Limited, dated 02 January 2020 (received on 06 January 2020) approved 07 February 2020 under 01054H/527/P5(6b) for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 7 - The development shall not be carried out other than in full  accordance with the hereby approved details [Condition 7 - Technical Note, AQ101903c3 March (received on 16 March 2020)] for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 8 - The development shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the approved detailed drainage design [Drainage Report ref. RCEF64914- Revision B prepared by RPS dated September 2019 received on 11/09/2019.approved 17 October 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(8)] and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 9 - The development shall not be completed other than in accordance with the details approved on the 08/01/2018 under application 01054H/527/P4(11i) [Consolidated Contamination Assessment Report ref. GWPR2357/CAR/December 2017 V1.01 December 2017 prepared by ground & water received on 12/12/2017].
Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 11 - The development shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the approved schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature [approved on 14 January 2020 under 01054H/527/P5(12)]with relation to internal water use consumption.
Condition : 12 - The development shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the approved sustainable materials [approved 06 November 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(13)].

Condition : 13 - All landscaping comprised in the approved details (06 November 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(14)) shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within three years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity.
The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained in accordance with the approved management programme.
Condition : 14 - The windows formed in the east side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 15 - A. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the location of Electric Vehicle charging points and any associated connections as shown in the plans submitted. 
B. Prior to the first occupation of the development, the parking, loading and turning spaces as set out in the approved plans and the details approved under part A of this condition, shall be constructed and made available for use. This shall include a minimum 20% 'active' Electric Vehicle Charging spaces and 20% 'passive' Electric Vehicle Charging spaces. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter. No loading or unloading shall occur on the public highway.

Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Tree Protection Plan (Staines rd prop gf plan rev B received on 13/11/2017) approved on 13/11/2017 under application 01054H/527/P4(18).

Condition : 17 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Biodiversity Enhancement Strategy [approved 14 July 2017 under 01054H/527/P4].
This strategy shall be implemented prior to any building being first occupied and enhancement measures shall be maintained throughout the lifetime of the development or in accordance with the strategy set out in the Landscape Management Plan.

Condition : 18 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the stage 1 written scheme of investigation (WSI) (Written Scheme of Investigation for Archaeological Evaluation ref. 116650.01 dated April 2017 prepared by Wessex Archaeology received on 14/07/2017) approved on 08/09/2017 under application 01054H/527/P4(20i).
If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified by stage 1 then for those parts of the site which have archaeological interest a stage 2 WSI shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing. For land that is included within the stage 2 WSI, no demolition/development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed stage 2 WSI which shall include: 
A. The statement of significance and research objectives, the programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works 
B. The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication & dissemination and deposition of resulting material. This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the stage 2 WSI.

Condition : 19 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Delivery and Servicing Plan (Revision.4, approved 06 November 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(20-27) and so maintained at all times thereafter.
Condition : 20 - The development shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the approved Travel Plan (approved 06 November 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(20-27)).

Condition : 21 - Prior to first occupation of the development the cycle parking shall have been provided and made available for use in accordance with the details on plans submitted, including the bars to which the frame of a bike can be locked, and the racks are to be power assisted. The cycle parking shall be so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 22 - A minimum of seven Wheelchair User Dwellings, built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard, shall be provided as shown on the plans submitted. The wheelchair units shall be so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 23 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing access from Staines Road at the Eastern end of the site is closed and reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement. Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the western access shall be widened to measure 4.8m and altered to include a raised footway across the access.

Condition : 24 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Parking Management Plan [approved 06 November 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(20-27)].
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and so maintained at all times thereafter.
Condition : 25 - There shall be no pedestrian or vehicular access through the Northern boundary of the site.

Condition : 26 - The development shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the approved details of road markings and signage [approve 06 November 2019 under 01054H/527/P5(20-27)].
The approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation and so maintained at all times thereafter.
